program.section_heading: Intermediate English Fluency Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Demonstrate ability to communicate with appropriate syntax and control of grammatical patterns in most extended conversations and interviews.
Demonstrate ability to write brief, paragraph length, compositions on previously discussed topics and exhibit control of basic grammatical patterns.
Demonstrate understanding of essential points of discussion or speeches of familiar or unfamiliar topics.
Demonstrate understanding of simple authentic reading materials on common topics and interpret the meaning of readings on specialized topics.

notes: Noncredit certificate counted in hours; course hours (108 each) and total (216 hours) taken from the Program Requirements section.
Catalog prints codes without a space (ESL341, ESL342); these match closed-list ESL 341 and ESL 342.
The 'Required' block states 'Complete the following number of hours: 216', recorded as the block's stated total.
Program Map repeats the same two courses (Fall: ESL341, Spring: ESL342) and was not recorded as separate blocks.
Course title 'ESL Beginning Literacy' for ESL341 seems unusual for an intermediate certificate, but it is printed as such and matches the closed list.
